help.recon:
Usage: st bugout recon {validate,run,status,events,control}
Frozen manifests, compact journal facts, and review leads only.
help.recon validate:
Usage: st bugout recon validate --manifest FILE
Validate without target access.
help.recon run:
Usage: st bugout recon run --manifest FILE --journal FILE
Run or resume the exact immutable plan.
help.recon status:
Usage: st bugout recon status --journal FILE
At most 1 KiB; no raw logs.
help.recon events:
Usage: st bugout recon events --journal FILE [--cursor N]
At most 8 KiB with a continuation cursor.
help.recon control:
Usage: st bugout recon control {pause,resume,cancel,feedback,rules} --journal FILE --revision N [--file FILE]
Revision-bound controls and durable hunter dispositions.

usage.when: bounded manifest-driven recon: validate, run, status, events, control
